settings.order: rate, repeat, protocol; protocol order rotates by repeat

measurement_boundaries.throughput: Unique origin-node completions per second, using disjoint origin observations; replicas are not summed as replicated system output.
measurement_boundaries.latency: Transaction-weighted mean origin-node payload-ready consensus completion latency in a steady-state completion window. Each adapter records its precise start point; client ingress differs.
measurement_boundaries.traffic: Sum of successful replica TCP stream writes, including protocol data, authentication, framing and application ACKs. Excludes metrics/client control, TCP/IP headers and kernel retransmissions. Reads recorded separately, never added to writes.
measurement_boundaries.conditions: Matched node count, hardware, offered rate, serialized transaction size,100ms origin ingress cadence, warmup and measurement duration. Native internal consensus batching, worker counts, timeouts, cryptography and storage are retained and recorded per implementation. Configured one-way kernel delay and protocol bound are matched; native timer multipliers and independent batching remain implementation-specific. Mysticeti maps its leader-readiness timeout to the requested bound.
measurement_boundaries.capacity: Two offered-load points measure sustained delivery under these conditions; no maximum capacity is inferred.
